Newcity’s Music 45 Showcases Chicago’s Music World This November

Listen to audio version of this article
Instaread
Sponsored by

Newcity’s November 2027 issue will feature our biennial survey of Chicago’s music world, the Music 45: Who Keeps Chicago in Tune.

The 2027 edition will highlight both the musicians and behind-the-scenes figures who shape the music landscape of Chicago, from hip-hop to classical and beyond.

Music organizations, venues and brands in adjacent spaces are encouraged to advertise in this edition, an opportunity to connect with the most passionate of our city’s music community.

To view rates or reserve space, please visit our ad portal or email advertising@newcity.com with any questions.

Publication Date: November (Street date October 29)
Advertising space deadline: September 22
Artwork deadline: October 6
